text: The user is planning a beach trip and considering booking a ride-sharing service to get there. The user has had a lot of recent experience with Uber, taking at least 10 Uber rides during a week-long family vacation to Hawaii from 20 April 2023 to 27 April 2023.
For the Hawaii vacation from 20 April 2023 to 27 April 2023, the user and family flew American Airlines from their hometown to Honolulu, then took a connecting flight to Maui.

The user is flying to a beach destination and needs a ride from the airport to the beach. The user's airport for this trip is a bit smaller, so the user is unsure whether all airport transportation services will be available there.

The assistant said airport transportation options include Uber Airport and Lyft Airport pickups at many airports, taxis at most airports, shared-ride airport shuttles that often need advance booking, private car services, region-specific services such as Wingz, ExecuCar or Blacklane, and hotel shuttles, which can be free.

To check which ride services operate at a specific airport, the assistant suggested looking at the airport website's Ground Transportation section, the airport app, a Google search for airport transportation plus the IATA airport code, the Uber or Lyft websites, the airport information desk, and the airport's social media accounts.

The user has been flying a lot recently and is trying to accumulate airline miles. The assistant said American Airlines flyers earn miles through the AAdvantage programme, which has partners including British Airways, Iberia and Finnair.

The user is trying to offset their carbon footprint from flying by using a carbon offset calculator and donating to a reforestation project. The user has already offset around 5,000 kg of CO2 emissions from their flights.

The assistant said 5,000 kg of CO2 offset is roughly equivalent to planting around 250 trees and letting them grow for 10 years, avoiding about 12,500 miles of driving emissions, or saving about 2,500 kWh of energy.
The user is considering a future trip to a destination that requires a layover and asked how to book a connecting flight and what to keep in mind when booking one.

The assistant's steps for booking a connecting flight were to search on a travel site such as Expedia, Kayak or Skyscanner, or on an airline website, selecting Multi-city or Connecting flights; check the layover duration, connection airport and gate or terminal details; then review all flight numbers, dates and times before confirming.

The assistant advised that when booking a connecting flight the traveller should weigh layover length (too short risks missing the connection), check whether separate airlines are in an alliance, confirm checked baggage transfers, check visa requirements for the layover country, consider travel insurance covering disruptions, and have a backup plan for flight changes.

The user is planning a round-trip flight to San Francisco from 10 to 14 May 2023 (the 10th to the 14th of next month, with next month being May 2023), flying into San Francisco International Airport (SFO). The user is open to flying out of their hometown airport at any time of day.

The user is considering Southwest Airlines for the San Francisco trip, having had a good experience on a direct flight from their hometown to Las Vegas for a conference from the 15th to the 18th of March.
The user's hometown airport is a Southwest Airlines hub, which the user hopes will help them get a good deal on the flight to SFO.

The assistant suggested finding Southwest deals using the Southwest Low Fare Calendar, comparison tools such as Google Flights, Skyscanner or Kayak with price alerts, considering Oakland International Airport (OAK), about 30 miles from San Francisco, watching Southwest sales, and booking at least 2 to 3 weeks in advance.

The user asked whether they could earn miles on Southwest flights given their loyalty to United Airlines and American Airlines. The assistant said miles on United or American cannot be earned on Southwest flights, because Southwest's own loyalty programme, Rapid Rewards, is separate. The user said they will consider joining Rapid Rewards.
The user has accumulated a decent amount of miles on United Airlines and American Airlines and hopes to use them for an upgrade on their next long-haul flight.

The assistant said United upgrade awards come as CPU (Complimentary Premier Upgrades) and RPU (Regional Premier Upgrades), with indicative costs of 15,000 to 30,000 miles one-way for domestic flights and 30,000 to 60,000 miles one-way for international flights. Basic Economy fares are not eligible for upgrades.

The assistant said American Airlines upgrades can be bought with 15,000-mile or 25,000-mile upgrade awards, with indicative costs of 15,000 to 25,000 miles one-way for domestic flights and 25,000 to 50,000 miles one-way for international flights. Basic Economy fares are not eligible, and availability is limited.
The user is planning a birthday trip to Hawaii and asked for recommendations of good hiking trails on Kauai. The assistant wished the user a happy birthday.

The assistant recommended Kauai hiking trails: Kalalau Trail (22 miles along the Na Pali Coast, with a 4-mile round-trip day hike to Hanakapi'ai Beach), Waimea Canyon Trail (11-mile out-and-back), Sleeping Giant Trail (3.6-mile out-and-back in Wailua), Mahaulepu Heritage Trail (4-mile out-and-back), Awaawapuhi Trail (6.2-mile out-and-back in Koke'e State Park), 'Opaeka'a Falls Trail (1.5 miles) and Kukui Trail (2.5 miles).
The user has heard Kauai is prone to rain and asked whether there are waterfalls worth visiting that are accessible via a hike.

The assistant listed Kauai waterfalls reachable by hike or paddle: Wailua River and Fern Grotto, 'Opaeka'a Falls (150 feet, 1.5-mile trail), Uluwehi or Secret Falls (100 feet, about a 5-mile kayak plus a 1-mile hike), Waipuna Falls (20 feet, Kilauea), Kuilau Ridge Trail waterfalls (about 4 miles round trip) and the 'Iliau Nature Loop (3 miles).
The user wants to try local cuisine, specifically laulau and kalua pig, at restaurants on Kauai.

The assistant recommended Kauai restaurants for laulau and kalua pig: Mark's Place in Lihue (a combo plate), Kintaro in Lihue, Hanalei Gourmet in Hanalei, Bar Acuda in Hanalei, Kalaheo Cafe in Kalaheo, Eating House 1849 in Kapaa (Sunday brunch) and The Fish Hopper in Kapaa.

The assistant described laulau as pork, beef or chicken wrapped in taro leaves and steamed, and kalua pig as pork slow-cooked in an underground oven called an imu. Other local dishes it named were poi, loco moco and shave ice.
The user is planning a snorkelling trip to see sea turtles and monk seals on Kauai and asked for spots known for those sightings.

The assistant recommended Kauai sea turtle snorkelling spots: Hanalei Bay, Anini Beach, Poipu Beach and Koloa Landing. It recommended monk seal spots: Poipu Beach, Kekaha Beach and Polihale State Park.

The user was considering a snorkelling tour to the Na Pali Coast. The assistant said it is an incredible experience but noted the coast is only reachable by boat or hike, can have rough seas especially in winter, and is physically demanding.
The user decided to book a snorkelling tour to the Na Pali Coast because they have heard so much about its beauty and want to see the marine life there.

The assistant recommended Na Pali Coast snorkelling tour operators: Na Pali Coast Tours (operating on Kauai for over 30 years), Kauai Sea Rider (also sunset cruises and whale watching), Island Adventures Kauai (smaller groups, also kayaking and hiking) and Kauai Snorkeling Tours. It advised booking early, especially in peak season.
The user is planning a birthday trip to Hawaii in October 2023 and asked for good snorkelling spots on the islands.

The assistant recommended snorkelling spots by island: Oahu's Hanauma Bay Nature Preserve and Shark's Cove; Maui's Molokini Crater and Honolua Bay; Kauai's Poipu Beach and Ke'e Beach; the Big Island's Kealakekua Bay and Hapuna Beach; and Lanai's Hulopoe Beach.
The user plans to stay on Oahu and is interested in snorkelling at Hanauma Bay Nature Preserve and Shark's Cove.

The assistant said Hanauma Bay is closed on Tuesdays, visitors must watch a short educational video before entering, and arriving by 7:00 AM helps beat crowds and secure parking. It said Shark's Cove is best snorkelled in the calmer summer months of June to September.

The user is also planning to hike on Oahu and asked for trail recommendations. The assistant suggested Manoa Falls Trail (1.6 miles, about 2 to 3 hours), Makapu'u Point Lighthouse Trail (2 miles), Diamond Head State Monument (1.5 miles), Olomana Trail (4.5 miles), Kuliouou Ridge Trail (4 miles) and Waimea Valley Trail (3.5 miles).
The user is thinking of doing the Manoa Falls Trail in the morning and asked for a good place to grab breakfast or brunch nearby beforehand.

The assistant suggested breakfast or brunch spots near the Manoa Falls Trail, all within about a 20-minute drive: Morning Glass Coffee + Cafe, The Nook Neighborhood Bistro, Koko Head Cafe and Manoa Marketplace.
The user plans to have breakfast at Morning Glass Coffee + Cafe before hiking the Manoa Falls Trail and asked how to get to the trailhead from there.

The assistant gave driving directions from Morning Glass Coffee + Cafe to the Manoa Falls Trailhead, noting that trailhead parking is limited and the road is narrow and winding. It also said bus route 4 or 6 runs from the University of Hawaii at Manoa campus, and that Uber or Lyft is an option.
The user is thinking of spending the rest of their birthday relaxing on a beach on Oahu and asked for a beach that is not too crowded.

The assistant recommended less crowded Oahu beaches: Kaimana Beach in the Kahala neighbourhood, Kailua Beach on the windward coast, Lanikai Beach on the windward coast, Shark's Cove, and Waialae Beach in Hawaii Kai.
The user is updating their LinkedIn profile and asked for tips on how to highlight academic achievements in the education section.

The assistant advised listing all relevant degrees and certifications in a consistent format with institution, degree, field and dates, and highlighting a GPA of 3.5 or higher, honours, scholarships, relevant coursework, extracurricular activities and media such as certificates or projects.
The user completed a Data Science certification in April 2023 (last month relative to the session date of 25 May 2023) and needs to add it to their LinkedIn profile.

The assistant advised adding certifications in LinkedIn's dedicated Certifications section, including the exact certification name, issuing organisation, issue date, expiry date if any, a brief description of the skills it shows, and an uploaded copy of the certificate.
The user is considering going back to school for a Master's degree, possibly in Business Administration (MBA), and asked how to research and compare programmes.

The assistant advised comparing MBA programmes on accreditation (AACSB or ACBSP), format (full-time, part-time, online or hybrid, or executive), curriculum and specialisations, faculty, location, total cost, admissions requirements such as GMAT or GRE, networking, student support, programme length and graduate outcomes.
The user is considering the University of Florida and Arizona State University for their MBA.

The assistant described the University of Florida Warrington College of Business MBA as ranked #24 in US News 2022 Best Online MBA Programs and #34 in Bloomberg Businessweek 2021, with a 20:1 student-faculty ratio, an alumni network of over 70,000, in-state tuition of about $30,000 a year, out-of-state tuition of about $45,000 a year, and average scholarships of about $10,000.

The assistant described the Arizona State University W. P. Carey School of Business MBA in Tempe, Arizona as ranked #25 in US News 2022 Best Online MBA Programs and #27 in Bloomberg Businessweek 2021, with a 15:1 student-faculty ratio, an alumni network of over 90,000, in-state tuition of about $25,000 a year, out-of-state tuition of about $40,000 a year, and average scholarships of about $10,000.
The user is still deciding on a Master's degree and plans to reach out to current students and alumni of both the University of Florida and Arizona State University programmes before deciding.

The user asked for tips to optimise their LinkedIn profile for data science job opportunities. The assistant suggested data science keywords in the headline, summary and skills, highlighting the certification, showcasing projects, listing skills such as Python, R and SQL, getting endorsements, joining data science groups and publishing posts.

The user asked for help writing a message to current students and alumni of the two MBA programmes. The assistant drafted a template email asking about motivations for choosing the university, valuable skills gained, the academic environment and faculty support, internship and networking opportunities, and challenges faced.

The user is looking for summer cocktail inspiration using fresh herbs from their garden. The user has been enjoying Hendrick's gin picked up the week of 31 July 2023 (last week relative to the session date of 11 August 2023).

The assistant recommended Hendrick's gin cocktails with garden herbs: Cucumber-Basil Refresher, Garden Gimlet (mint), Rose Petal Spritz, Lemon-Thyme Fizz, Elderflower Collins and Mint to Be (ginger beer, mint and lime).
The user asked about using lavender in cocktails and said they have been experimenting with Negroni recipes at home, finding that Hendrick's gin brings out the flavours.
The assistant gave a lavender syrup recipe of 1 cup granulated sugar, 1 cup water and 1/4 cup dried lavender buds, steeped 10 to 15 minutes, strained and refrigerated for up to 2 weeks.

The assistant suggested Hendrick's lavender cocktails: Lavender Gin Fizz, Lavender Dream and Lavender Bee's Knees. It advised starting with a small amount of lavender syrup and pairing lavender with citrus such as lemon or grapefruit.
The user has tried making a Negroni at home five times since their friend Emma taught them, using Hendrick's gin and Carpano Antica vermouth, and is getting closer to getting it right.

The assistant recommended Campari alternatives for the Negroni: Cynar (1/2 oz with 1/2 oz Carpano Antica), Aperol (1 oz), Luxardo Bitter (1/2 oz), Suze (1 oz) and Meletti (1 oz). It suggested adjusting the bitter-to-sweet vermouth ratio to taste.
The assistant suggested a White Negroni, substituting dry vermouth such as Dolin for the sweet vermouth and using a bitter liqueur such as Suze or Luxardo Bitter, for a crisp and herbaceous drink.
The user plans to try a White Negroni because they have heard it showcases the gin and bitter liqueur, and asked for a recipe and balancing tips.

The assistant's White Negroni recipe was 1 1/2 oz Hendrick's gin, 1/2 oz Suze (or Luxardo Bitter), and 1/2 oz Dolin Dry Vermouth, stirred for 20 to 30 seconds over ice, strained into a chilled coupe and garnished with an orange or lemon twist.

The user asked about citrus to pair with gin and lavender beyond grapefruit and lemon. The assistant suggested orange (blood oranges), yuzu, kumquat, satsuma and bergamot, and advised using fresh citrus and citrus peels.
As of 30 November 2023, the user has tried making a Negroni at home 10 times since their friend Emma showed them how, up from five times in August 2023.

The user is looking for a unique cocktail to serve at their next dinner party that incorporates lavender or grapefruit. The assistant suggested Lavender Gin Fizz, Lavender Dream, Grapefruit Basil Martini, Grapefruit Rosemary Sparkler, Lavender Grapefruit Spritz and Grapefruit Lavender Collins.
The user plans to try the Lavender Gin Fizz and the Grapefruit Basil Martini. The assistant's Lavender Gin Fizz used 1 1/2 oz gin, 1/2 oz lime juice, 1/2 oz lavender syrup and 1/2 oz simple syrup.

The assistant gave infusion guidance: lavender gin with 1/4 cup dried lavender buds per litre of gin for 2 to 3 days, lavender vodka for 1 to 2 weeks, and cucumber or mint gin infusions for 2 to 5 days, using a rough starting ratio of 1 part flavouring to 4 parts spirit.
The user intends to experiment with infusing gin with cucumber and mint separately, to get the flavours of a Cucumber Gimlet, and will combine the infusions afterwards to taste.
The user recently hosted a dinner party and served a Cranberry Sparkler, which was a huge hit with guests.

The assistant recommended classic cocktails to try: Classic Gin Martini (2:1 or 3:1 gin to dry vermouth), Pimm's Cup, Bee's Knees, French 75, Corpse Reviver No. 2, and for other spirits the Old Fashioned, Daiquiri and Sidecar.

The user has been experimenting with Pimm's No. 1 and plans to make a Pimm's Cup. The user also plans to make a Bee's Knees with a homemade honey syrup because they love the combination of gin and honey.

The assistant's honey syrup guidance was a 1:1 honey to water ratio, gently heated over low heat and whisked until dissolved without boiling, cooled, and stored in the fridge for up to 2 weeks. Flavourings such as citrus peel, herbs or ginger can be added while dissolving.
The user recently picked up a bottle of Hendrick's gin and is really enjoying it, including in a Bee's Knees.
The assistant suggested other gin cocktails: Gin Rickey, Gin-Gin Mule, Aviation, Monkey Gland and Last Word, and described London Dry, Plymouth and New Western gin styles as options to explore.
